root_cause.text: The removal of page recycling logic from `emac_run_xdp()` to support AF_XDP zero-copy mode inadvertently neglected to implement equivalent cleanup in the caller `emac_rx_packet()` for non-zero-copy `XDP_DROP` operations, causing page pool memory leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "Page recycling was removed from the XDP_DROP path in emac_run_xdp() to avoid conflicts with AF_XDP zero-copy mode... However, this causes a memory leak when running XDP programs that drop packets in non-zero-copy mode," and the patch fixes this by adding `page_pool_recycle_direct(pool, page)` in `emac_rx_packet()` specifically when `*xdp_state == ICSSG_XDP_CONSUMED`.
